en: Vintage sepia postcard showing the exterior moat or ditch along the side of a large stone castle. The path in the moat has several low stone or earth structures laid out. Superimposed at the upper right are three oval portrait medallions of men in military or formal dress, each with a small caption bearing their names and dates, presented as martyrs. At the bottom is an Italian caption identifying the scene as the castle moat in Trento and referring to the Trentino martyrs.
